title: [Feature][GLM-5.3-Flash] Enable torch.compile for GLM-5.3-Flash backbone and MTP
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Enable `torch.compile` for the GLM-5.3-Flash text backbone and MTP draft model.

- Keep KDA state updates and Triton-based normalization behind custom-op boundaries so serialized FX/AOT artifacts remain reusable across processes.
- Register KDA as a PIECEWISE splitting op and normalize into a caller-owned output buffer. This prevents capture of the metadata-free profiling path and stale-output reads during graph replay.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Compilation settings now take effect for the backbone and MTP, and PIECEWISE prefill produces correct outputs for the previously failing requests.

Draft compilation requires `"enforce_eager": false` in the speculative config. Explicit eager mode remains supported.

### How was this patch tested?

- **CPU:** 95 related tests passed, covering runtime metadata, stable output buffers, and FULL graph compatibility.
- **A3:** W8A8, V1, MTP5, P DP2/TP8 + D DP8/TP2, PIECEWISE prefill and FULL decode. Cold and hot compilation-cache runs each passed 32 concurrent PD requests across all eight D instances.
- **A3 runtime:** CANN 9.2.0, PyTorch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post7, vLLM 0.31.0 (`db9527a4`).
- **950DT:** TP8 + EP MXFP8 validation with V1, FULL_DECODE_ONLY and three-token compiled MTP.
- **AIME2026:** Default-sampling evaluation is running; final accuracy is pending.


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
